name: exame-tests
description: Suite de testes (xUnit + Vitest + Playwright) para o sistema MinhasFinancas

scripts.test:bun: node scripts/run-all-tests.mjs bun:test:unit bun:test:integration:resumo bun:test:web:resumo bun:test:e2e:resumo
scripts.test:api: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:api:bun: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix tests/web install && npm --prefix tests/e2e install && npm --prefix tests/e2e run install:browsers-with-deps
scripts.install:all:bun: bun install && bun install --cwd tests/web && bun install --cwd tests/e2e && bun run --cwd tests/e2e install:browsers-with-deps
